name: Strawberries
description: Sweet, fragrant berries with leafy green caps. Keep them cool and dry, and wash just before eating.

storage.label: Whole
storage.advice: Use a container in the crisper. Check for damaged berries when you unpack.
storage.caution: Moisture encourages spoilage; wash just before use.

buying: Choose sound berries without crushed spots or visible mold.
Check the bottom of the punnet as well as the top.
freshness: Discard moldy berries, then check the fruit that touched them. Do not trim mold off soft berries.
leftovers: Blend sound, ripe berries into a smoothie.

freezing.instructions: Wash, remove the caps, and dry. Spread on a tray to freeze, then transfer to a freezer bag or container.
freezing.quality: Thawed fruit is softer; use it in smoothies or sauces.
